title: [Notification API - POST /api/v1/notifications/mark-all-read] Logged-Out Bearer Token Continues Mutating Notification Read State (HTTP 200 OK) After POST /api/traveler/logout
environment: Staging (STAG) · API Gateway / Notification Service & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/home)
test_account: Isolated QA Traveler Session Invalidated via POST /api/traveler/logout (<REDACTED_LOGGED_OUT_QA_TOKEN>)
steps_to_reproduce: Authenticate an isolated QA Traveler session via POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/login.
Log out that session via POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/logout (HTTP 200 OK) and confirm GET /api/traveler/me rejects the token with HTTP 401 ('You are not logged in.').
Single-Variable Session Check: Send POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/v1/notifications/mark-all-read using Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_LOGGED_OUT_QA_TOKEN>.
Record HTTP status, data.updated count, and meta.requestId.
actual_result: - POST /api/v1/notifications/mark-all-read accepts the logged-out Bearer token and returns HTTP 200 OK: {"data": {"updated": 8}, "meta": {"requestId": "32306f87-02cb-437b-9039-c1ae4db87a1a", "timestamp": "2026-11-19T06:57:59.900Z"}}, mutating 8 notification records after session logout (GET /api/v1/notifications?limit=5 also continues returning HTTP 200 OK).
expected_result:
- Per Cross-Service Session Lifecycle & API Standard (Confluence 524593), once a Traveler logs out via POST /api/traveler/logout, Gateway / Notification v1 endpoints must reject the revoked token with HTTP 401 AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED.
- Zero notification records may be modified by a logged-out session token.

evidence.console: Test Case STAG-API-205 | requestId=32306f87-02cb-437b-9039-c1ae4db87a1a | Single-Variable Delta: Replay logged-out Bearer token.
evidence.network: POST /api/traveler/logout -> 200 OK; GET /api/traveler/me -> 401; POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/v1/notifications/mark-all-read -> HTTP 200 OK (data.updated=8, requestId=32306f87-02cb-437b-9039-c1ae4db87a1a).
evidence.notes: Frontend chunk 0lu641k7h1gc_.js calls /api/v1/notifications/* via NEXT_PUBLIC_API_GATEWAY_URL. Gateway JWT verification validates signature/exp claims without checking Strapi session revocation / jti denylist. | Security Classification: OWASP A07:2025 Authentication Failures (CWE-613 Insufficient Session Expiration) & A01:2025 · OWASP API2:2023 Broken Authentication | OWASP Remediation: Propagate session revocation (Redis jti denylist or session introspection) to API Gateway /api/v1/* auth guard (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Session_Management_Cheat_Sheet.html).

classification: Confirmed Bug — Revoked Traveler Session Token Continues Mutating State on /api/v1/notifications/*
